info.description: Internal REST API wrapping yt-dlp and ffmpeg for downloading and searching media from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Threads, X (Twitter), SoundCloud, Facebook, Pinterest, and more.
info.title: yt-dlp Media Downloader & Search API

post.description: Auto-detects platform and media type (video, audio, image, or carousel) from URL for non-YouTube sources; SoundCloud stays audio-only. Supports response_mode: url (default) or async.
Downloads Facebook Reels, Watch, and public videos.

get.description: Streams a previously downloaded file. Pass ?delete_after=true to automatically remove the file after transfer completes.

parameters.description: Delete file immediately after download finishes
parameters.name: delete_after

delete.description: Manually deletes a temporary file from disk before its TTL expires.

get.description: Checks API readiness, yt-dlp/gallery-dl/ffmpeg binary availability, active concurrency, and temp file count.

post.description: Extracts metadata, thumbnail, and available formats/direct URLs without downloading media files.
Auto-detects and downloads Instagram Reels, Videos, Photos, Carousels, or Stories (supports cookies/instagram.txt).

get.description: Returns the current progress snapshot and final DownloadResult (when completed) for an async job.
Opens a Server-Sent Events (text/event-stream) stream pushing real-time download progress, postprocessing status, and completion payload.
get.summary: Stream async job progress via SSE

post.description: Auto-detects and downloads Pinterest image pins, video pins, GIFs, and idea pin carousels (auto-resolves pin.it short links).

get.description: Returns primary supported platforms and their capabilities/cookies hints.
Searches YouTube or SoundCloud for tracks and videos.

post.description: Downloads SoundCloud track as MP3/M4A/Opus with optional embedded cover art. Accepts a SoundCloud URL or search query.
Auto-detects and downloads Threads videos, photos, and carousel posts (supports threads.com and threads.net).
Auto-detects TikTok video vs photo slideshow (expanding short links like vt.tiktok.com), or forces video/audio when type is specified.
Auto-detects and downloads X / Twitter videos, GIFs, images, and multi-item posts.
Downloads YouTube audio as MP3/M4A/Opus with optional embedded thumbnail. Accepts a YouTube URL or a search keyword (auto-plays top result).

get.description: Searches YouTube videos/tracks by keyword. Useful for !ytsearch and !play bot commands.

post.description: Downloads YouTube video in MP4 (prefers H.264/AAC by default).
